ad_b_text: ad. What do you think of my wooden Christmas wreath? ☺️🎄🌟 Would you believe it started life as a preloved side table I found in my local thrift store?! I’m honestly so happy with how it turned out! It’s bright, bold, and full of festive cheer... and the best bit? I get to bring it out year after year  ❤️ If you’re making any festive projects with Sharpie markers this season, please tag me! ad_b_text: #ad Bringing back a childhood holiday dessert I’ve loved forever — pecan tea tassies made with all my @kroger baking staples 🤍✨ These wintery treats are always a hit at our holiday gatherings! All you need are mini muffin tins and the following ingredients:  Ingredients for pastry:  3 oz cream cheese (room temp) 1/2 cup unsalted butter (room temp) 1 cup flour Pinch of salt  Ingredients for pecan filling:  1 egg  3/4 cup brown sugar  1 Tbsp unsalted butter (room temp) 1 tsp vanilla  2/3 cup pecan crumbles  Pinch of salt  Directions for pastry:  1. Blend cream cheese and butter together until smooth.  2. Stir in flour & salt. Knead crumbly dough into a ball.  3. Chill dough for 20 minutes. Once chilled, form about 18 balls and place in your mini muffin tin (press dough firmly down, forming an indent enough to place filling)  Directions for filling:  1. Beat eggs, sugar, butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.  2. Split your pecan amount in half and add half to the filling mixture. 3. Add filling to the top the dough cups.  4. Top the cups with the remaining pecans.  Bake at 325 for around 25 minutes. Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Enjoy! #KrogerPartner #KrogerHolidays #ChristmasCookies #ChristmasCookieRecipe
